display.purpose: Hero and section giants. 200px desktop / 110px mobile. whitespace-nowrap; meant to dominate the viewport.

display-small.purpose: Mobile size of the display giants (110px).

body.purpose: The 12px functional workhorse: product info, controls, navigation, data, legal copy.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, control labels, section headers, badges. Body size, uppercase transform.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Default easing for route View Transitions and state changes.

motion.name: view-transition
motion.purpose: Route cross-fade duration (PageTransition); disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: threshold-reveal
motion.purpose: Signature image reveal: grayscale(100%) contrast(200%) brightness(0.5) resolving to full color, as if developing.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The committed call to action: ink fill, paper text, 1px ink border, inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'FeatureMono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: normal; color: #ffffff; background: #000000; border: 1px solid #000000; border-radius: 0; padding: 10px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ffffff; color: #000000; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #000000; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #cccccc; border-color: #cccccc; color: #ffffff; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quieter committed action: paper fill, ink text, 1px ink border, inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: 'FeatureMono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: normal; color: #000000; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #000000; border-radius: 0; padding: 10px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #000000; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #000000; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Underline Button
components.description: Low-emphasis, in-flow action. Text plus underline; the colored variant uses Electric Blue.
components.css: .ds-btn-underline { font-family: 'FeatureMono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: normal; color: #000000; background: none; border: none; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-underline:hover { text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-underline:disabled { color: #cccccc; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-underline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #000000; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A single bottom rule, not a box. No fill, no inner shadow, no box outline on focus (caret + bottom border signal it).
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; font-family: 'FeatureMono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #000000; } .ds-input { width: 100%; font-family: 'FeatureMono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #000000; background: #ffffff; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #000000; border-radius: 0; padding: 4px 0; appearance: none; } .ds-input:disabled { border-bottom-color: #cccccc; color: #cccccc; }

components.name: Empty State
components.description: Ink uppercase label (never inactive gray) plus an optional bordered CTA routing to the next useful surface.
components.html: NO ORDERS YET
components.css: .ds-empty { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 24px; } .ds-empty-label { font-family: 'FeatureMono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #000000; margin: 0; } .ds-empty-cta { font-family: 'FeatureMono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #000000; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #000000; border-radius: 0; padding: 10px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-empty-cta:hover { background: #000000; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Edge-pinned header link: 12px uppercase mono, state by weight/underline. On the live header it renders in mix-blend-exclusion over imagery.
components.html: CATALOGTIMELINECART 02
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'FeatureMono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #000000; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-link::selection { background: #cde100; color: #000000; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #000000; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: grbpwr.com is a fashion house run like a command line. A single monospace typeface (FeatureMono) speaks every word on the site, from a 12px care-label to a 200px display headline. There is no display/body pairing, no second voice, no decorative escape hatch. The identity lives in the scale jump and the cadence of that one mono face: tiny functional type sitting under giant type, both built from the same fixed-width letterforms. The surface is monochrome black on white (and a true inverted black theme), interrupted only by two committed accents. Everything is sharp-cornered and flat: depth is drawn with 1px rules, mix-blend-exclusion, and translucent overlays, never with shadow. The register is product in its rigor and editorial in its restraint. This is an authored object, not a configured theme.
keyCharacteristics: One monospace family carries display, body, label, data, and numerals.
Extreme type-scale contrast: 12px functional to 110/200px display, with little in between.
Monochrome base (#000/#fff) plus exactly two committed accents.
Flat by absolute rule: zero box-shadows anywhere in the codebase.
Sharp corners: radius 0 is the default; full-pill is reserved for tags and circular controls.
Severe, precise, deliberate. The garment is the hero; chrome stays quiet.

rules.name: The Two-Paint Rule
rules.body: Only two paints are ever added to the monochrome: Electric Blue for interaction, Acid Yellow for editorial selection. No third accent, no gradient, no tint.

rules.name: The Theme-Inverts-Highlight Rule
rules.body: The dark theme is a true inversion but also mutes the highlight token to gray (#535353). Electric Blue is a light-theme accent; on dark, interactivity is carried by weight, underline, and the persistent blue selection, not by accent fills.

rules.name: The Structural-Gray Rule
rules.body: #cccccc is for borders, dividers, and disabled affordances, not prose. It must never carry body copy or an empty-state message; at ~1.6:1 on paper it fails WCAG AA.

rules.name: The One-Voice Rule
rules.body: Never introduce a second font family. Display, body, button, label, numerals, and data are all FeatureMono at different sizes and weights.

rules.name: The Scale-Jump Rule
rules.body: The contrast between 12px and 110/200px is intentional and load-bearing. Resist inventing a comfortable mid-scale ramp.

rules.name: The Mono-Cadence Rule
rules.body: Never apply negative letter-spacing to the display sizes. FeatureMono is fixed-width; its rhythm is the point. Tracking stays normal.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are forbidden. Separate with a 1px border or a tonal surface, or don't separate at all.

rules.name: The Blend-Not-Float Rule
rules.body: Chrome over imagery uses mix-blend-exclusion so it reads against any background without a plate or shadow. The chrome blends into the image; it never floats above it.

dos: Do carry every word in FeatureMono. One family, scaled and weighted.
Do keep the surface monochrome and add only Electric Blue (interaction) or Acid Yellow (editorial selection).
Do separate surfaces with 1px borders, mix-blend-exclusion, or tonal layering, never shadow.
Do set empty-state and informational text in Ink, uppercase. Reserve #cccccc for borders, dividers, and disabled states.
Do keep corners sharp (radius 0). Full-pill is only for tags and circular controls.
Do preserve the deliberate keyboard focus ring: 2px solid var(--text), 2px offset, :focus-visible only, on interactive controls but not text inputs.
Do give every prefers-reduced-motion path a crossfade or instant fallback.
Do meet WCAG 2.1 AA: body text >=4.5:1, touch targets >=44px, visible focus.
donts: Don't ship generic Shopify/DTC templates or anything that reads as a default theme rather than an authored object.
Don't use cream/sand editorial-warm palettes. The base is true #000/#fff, never a warm-tinted near-white.
Don't use rounded soft cards, drop-shadow ghost cards, gradient accents, or pill-everything.
Don't add a second typeface, or tighten the display sizes with negative letter-spacing.
Don't add any box-shadow. Zero is the count; keep it there.
Don't put #cccccc (or any muted gray) on body copy, empty states, or placeholders.
Don't assume Electric Blue accent fills survive onto the dark theme; on dark, highlight mutes to gray.
